influences.name: Randy Newman
influences.context: I just really wanted, on this record, to kind of push my voice as an instrument and just be a lot more concise with the words... I found myself asking myself what would Randy Newman do? Would Randy Newman need a lot of words to say this, no, he would just come out and say it.

influences.name: The Cure
influences.context: One of the records that we've always really loved has been The Cure's Disintegration, because there are so many hooks on that record and they're sneaky hooks.

influences.name: Robert Smith
influences.context: there are little guitars that I think are the kind of thing that Robert Smith might've… like we were channelling our inner Robert Smith.

influences.name: The Beatles
influences.context: I remember being six years old and listening to Sgt. Pepper's with a pair of headphones going, "Oh there's something over here and something on this side. Why is that?"

influences.name: Steve Albini
influences.context: Up until now I had been trying to do the Steve Albini/photographic realism sort of thing.

influences.name: The Bonzo Dog Doo-Dah Band
influences.context: It comes from a song called "Death Cab for Cutie" by the '60s art-rock pranksters the Bonzo Dog Doo-Dah Band.

influences.name: Coldplay
influences.context: We're not a household name. We're not Coldplay. We're not Arcade Fire.

influences.name: Arcade Fire
influences.context: We're not a household name. We're not Coldplay. We're not Arcade Fire.

influences.name: various bands from early career
influences.context: We've been together longer than some of the bands that I came up emulating.
